problem.explanation: Put all numbers in a set for O(1) lookups. Iterate through the set. If `num - 1` is not in the set, it's the start of a sequence. Count how many consecutive numbers exist from this start.
hints: Add all elements to a hash set.
Look for the start of a sequence (where num - 1 is not in the set).
problem.statement_markdown: Given an unsorted array of integers `nums`, return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence. You must write an algorithm that runs in `O(n)` time.
problem.title: Longest consecutive sequence
